title: aira caryophyllea var. capillaris
intro: Aira caryophyllea var. capillaris, commonly known as Hair Grass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Aira caryophyllea var. capillaris include being a styptic agent to stop bleeding, and it is also used as an astringent and antiseptic. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
